title: Senior Officer- Dispatch & Logistics
description:
Applications from Persons with Disabilities (PwD) are welcome. Manage dispatch, logistics, warehouse, inventory, SAP SD, invoicing, e-Way Bills, stock audits,vehicle inspection, FIFO compliance and coordination with internal teams and transporters.

Key Skills: Shipment,Outbound logistics,Warehouse operations,Inventory,Delivery management,Warehouse,Saps,Inventory management
